Metadata.title: VanishPic — Temporary image hosting
Metadata.description: Temporary image upload and sharing with automatic expiry.

Common.simulated: Demo operation completed; no changes were applied.

Home.title: Upload an image
Home.uploadDescription: Share temporary images without creating an account. Images are deleted after 7 days without a visit.
Home.sevenDayExpiry: Images are automatically deleted after 7 days without a visit.
Home.retention: Files are deleted after {days} days without a view.
Home.demoRetention: Demo files are deleted 10 minutes after upload.
Home.defaultNotice: Temporary storage only. Keep your original file.
Home.dropTitle: Drop images or click to browse
Home.dropHint: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF · up to {maxMiB} MiB
Home.pasteHint: You can also paste images with Ctrl+V.
Home.batchLimit: You can upload up to {count} images at once.
Home.batchUploadSuccess: {count, plural, one {# image uploaded.} other {# images uploaded.}}
Home.batchUploadPartial: {uploaded} uploaded; {failed} failed. Failed files remain selected.
Home.deleteOwnHint: This immediately deletes its stored object and metadata and cannot be undone.
Home.bannedPermanent: This upload source is permanently banned.
Home.bannedTemporary: This upload source is banned until {date}.
Home.sourceWarning: This upload source has a content warning.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.dashboardDescription: Manage storage, access, moderation, and uploads.
Admin.demoBanner: Demo mode: changes are not saved.
Admin.settingsDescription: Customize the public site and operational policies.
Admin.imagesDescription: Review active images and remove policy violations.
Admin.eventsDescription: Moderation activity with reasons and raw details.
Admin.settingsGeneralDescription: Branding, page copy, notices, and public upload features.
Admin.settingsUploadDescription: Control batch uploads, browser history, and uploader actions.
Admin.settingsAccessDescription: Control who can upload and how often.
Admin.settingsLifecycleDescription: Configure expiry, warnings, bans, and audit retention.
Admin.settingsModerationDescription: Choose the review model, policy, and failure behavior.
Admin.setupHint: Choose where uploaded images are stored.
Admin.githubHint: Deleted files may remain in Git history.
Admin.githubPatKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored PAT
Admin.siteNameDescription: The product name shown in the header and public interface.
Admin.uploadTitleDescription: The primary heading above the public upload form.
Admin.uploadDescriptionHelp: Supporting text displayed below the upload page title.
Admin.siteFooterDescription: Optional text shown below the public upload interface.
Admin.showRecentUploads: Show recent uploads on the public page
Admin.showRecentUploadsDescription: Display images remembered locally by the current browser.
Admin.pasteUploadDescription: Accept image files from the clipboard outside editable fields.
Admin.maxBatchSizeDescription: Maximum number of images accepted in one selection, drop, or paste.
Admin.uploadConcurrencyDescription: Number of files uploaded at the same time in one browser.
Admin.historyLimitDescription: Maximum recent uploads retained in the uploader's browser.
Admin.allowUploaderDeleteDescription: Let uploaders delete their own images with the private browser token.
Admin.showExpiryTimeDescription: Display each image's estimated expiry in browser history.
Admin.showViewCountDescription: Display the current view count in browser history.
Admin.accessModeDescription: Allow anonymous uploads or require one shared site password.
Admin.accessPasswordConfigured: A shared password is currently configured.
Admin.uploadLimitDescription: Rate limit applied to each hashed upload source.
Admin.violationActionDescription: Choose whether policy violations also warn their upload source.
Admin.siteNoticeDescription: An operational notice shown in the public status summary.
Admin.auditLogDaysDescription: Number of days moderation events remain in D1.
Admin.retentionDaysDescription: Delete images after this many days without a successful view.
Admin.warningThresholdDescription: Automatically ban a source after it reaches this warning count.
Admin.autoBanHoursDescription: Duration of automatic bans; zero creates a permanent ban.
Admin.aiModerationDescription: Review image content with the configured Workers AI vision model.
Admin.aiFailModeDescription: Choose whether uploads continue when the moderation model fails.
Admin.aiModelDescription: Vision-capable Workers AI model used for content review.
Admin.aiPolicyDescription: Policy instructions supplied to the moderation model.
Admin.storageDescription: Object backend used by upload, delivery, and cleanup operations.
Admin.reason: Internal reason / optional detail shown to uploader

Notices.UPLOADER_WARNED: Your upload source received a content warning.
Notices.UPLOADER_TEMPORARILY_BANNED: Your upload source has been temporarily banned.
Notices.UPLOADER_PERMANENTLY_BANNED: Your upload source has been permanently banned.
Notices.AUTO_WARNING_THRESHOLD: The warning threshold was reached and this source was automatically banned.
Notices.MANUAL_TEMP_BAN: An administrator temporarily banned this source.
Notices.MANUAL_PERMANENT_BAN: An administrator permanently banned this source.
